glosses: Obsolete spelling of urteilen which was deprecated in 1902 following the Second Orthographic Conference of 1901.

examples.text: Es konnte sein, — vorläufig nämlich können jene so urtheilen, und ich muß, um den Uebergang Ihnen zu eröffnen, sie so urtheilen lassen, […]
examples.translation: It could be, — for the time being some can judge thusly and I must, to open the transition for them, let them judge that way […]
examples.english: It could be, — for the time being some can judge thusly and I must, to open the transition for them, let them judge that way […]
